notes:
Snapshot: Deal cooled after price review. Primary reason: unit economics don't pencil for their production reranking/chat mixes. Summary of interactions and kernel issues:
- 2024-06-20: Intro call (Ava/Daniel) — EmberLane technical + product. Use-case: customer support triage + high-precision reranking for fraud detection. Need: sub-200ms p95 chat, 30 qps sustained for batch reranking flows.
- 2024-07-02: Architecture deep-dive (Daniel, SE) — prefer VPC with ability to run on-prem for PHI-like datasets. Interested in Redwood Dedicated to guarantee latency.
- 2024-07-30: Pricing review (Ava) — asked for committed pricing to hit $150k ARR to justify dedicated pool. We proposed 3-tier commit with model quantization and batching suggestions from Optimize.
- 2024-08-12: POC kickoff (Daniel/SE) — 14-day POC to validate latency & cost using quantized Llama-2-70B variant. Fireflies: ff_2024-08-12_emberlane_poc (link).
- 2024-08-26: POC results (SE notes) — latency targets met with 8-bit quant + KV caching, but observed per-token inference cost still ~3x what EmberLane's finance model expects once including tail GPU-hour allocation and pre-warm overhead.
- 2024-09-05: Security questionnaire submitted; gap on HSM-backed KMS for key custody (they require internal KMS/HSM or full on-prem option). Drive refs: drive:/security/emberlane/security_faq_responses.docx
- 2024-09-12: Procurement call with CFO — CFO asked for full unit-econ breakdown: expected token mix, estimated 1M token run costs, GPU amortization, and commit vs burst model. We supplied cost model v2 (drive:/deals/emberlane/redwood_pricing_deck_v2.pdf).
- 2024-09-20: Radio silence after CFO indicated a "procurement freeze" pending next funding tranche; also reported competitor quotes: Anthropic offered committed discounted token tiers and a 12-month credit offset for infra migration. EmberLane engineering mentioned exploring self-host to reduce token tax.
Key objections captured:
- "Token tax still the killer" — CTO paraphrase: per-token pricing + expected query volumes make hosted too expensive unless we get larger discount or different pricing structure.
- CFO: "We cannot justify a $150k commit when expected run-rate is under $80k — need a smaller entry".
- Security: requirement for HSM or fully customer-managed KMS slowed decision.
Actions taken / offers made:
- Proposed smaller POC variant (2-GPU, 30-day) to demonstrate lower amortized GPU cost and cheaper burst model.
- Suggested Optimize-led tuning: aggressive batching, longer KV cache TTL for reranking, and Q8_0 quant profile — estimated 25-35% cost reduction if quality acceptable.
- Offered staged pricing: 6-month pilot with consumption cap and conversion credit toward a Dedicated commit.
Why deal stalled / lost risk:
- No internal executive champion after CTO pushed cost concerns to CFO.
- Procurement frozen until Oct budget re-approval; CFO expressed preference for Anthropic's committed discount or self-host option.
Next recommended SDR/AE steps:
- Pause heavy engineering work; keep lightweight comms. Check back first week of Oct 2024 post budget review.
- If re-engaged: present a concrete micro-POC pricing (line-item: GPU hours, token bands, infra amortization) and an explicit ROI scenario for first 6 months.
- Flag potential product ask: test a "token-banded" pricing pilot for mid-market customers to address percent-of-token concerns.
Closed/lost status note: As of 2024-09-30 EmberLane has not signed; likely outcome: paused or moved to competitor (Anthropic/self-host). Record as high-risk-close; re-open if procurement signals change.
